<title level="1" right="Action">[Sustain an Effect](/Actions.aspx?ID=2631) <actions string="" /></title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Exploration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=595" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 439

</column>

---

You Sustain one effect with a sustained duration while moving at half speed. Most such effects can be sustained for 10 minutes, though some specify they can be sustained for a different duration. Sustaining an effect that requires making complex decisions, such as _spectral weapon_, can make you [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15), as determined by the GM.
name: Sustain an Effect
